AutomationUpsertRequest.description: Body JSON do CRUD de automations (snake_case).

ByorRefreshRequest.description: BYOR refresh body (SPEC-50) — budget override opcional.

create_as_user_id.description:
SPEC-57 RF-003: cria a conversa em nome de outro usuário da mesma
org — exige scope `sessions:impersonate` (service users).

permissions.description: SPEC-29: regras allow/deny/ask por tool da conversa.

secrets.description:
SPEC-33 RF-003: NOMES de secrets do usuário a injetar no sandbox —
valores nunca trafegam neste payload.

McpServerConfig.description:
Flat-map config de um servidor MCP (paridade SDK upstream — sem wrapper
`.mcp.json`). Serializado como JSON em `mcp_servers.config_json`.

command.description: Comando (stdio) — executado via `docker exec` no sandbox.

headers.description: Headers HTTP (sse/http) — Authorization vem do OAuth store.

name.description: Nome único do servidor (chave do flat map).

timeout_seconds.description: Timeout por tool call (default 60s na guardrail da SPEC).

PermissionRuleDto.description: Uma regra de permissão de tool (SPEC-29): pattern+decision.

PlanLimits.description:
Plan limits parsed from `PlanRecord.LimitsJson` (SPEC-20 RF-001).
`null` on a field means unlimited. Parse is fail-open — malformed
JSON or invalid values yield PlanLimits PlanLimits.Empty (a config error must
never take the product down).

PlanPatchRequest.description: Plan patch body — campos nulos preservam o valor atual.

ScmConnectionRequest.description: Manual connection registration (BYO app; SPEC-53 fields).

SecretSetRequest.description: PUT body — plaintext travels once over TLS, stored encrypted.

SecurityPolicyUpdate.description:
SPEC-48 RF-003: editable policy fields. Every field null = inherit the
preset default; a null SecurityPolicyUpdate resets to
`balanced` with no overrides.

permissions.description: Rule set — null/empty clears the conversation override.

model.description: Model name for the next run.

profile.description: Profile name (`small|medium|large`) or null to clear.

info.description: Public REST surface (/api/v1, /api/acp, /v1 OpenAI-compat gateway). Auth: cookie session or `Authorization: Bearer sk-*`.
info.title: OpenHandsNET API
